title: Entity pulls him out of his body and scolds him out of depression

tellings.quote: night um I'm asleep and I was awake in the middle Night by an entity that snatched me out of my body

plain: In 1970, while stationed in Germany and sunk in depression, Joe McMoneagle says he woke in the middle of the night to find an entity that "snatched me out of my body" and then scolded him until he snapped out of it. McMoneagle, who later served as an Army psychic spy, tells this as something that happened to him.
